description: Turn a fax number as it is printed into international form, resolve which territory it belongs to, and say whether the Faxvio app will dial it and whether its prefix costs two pages per page. Handles the traps: a parenthesised (0), a leading 00 or 011, the shared dial codes, and the countries whose leading zero survives an international call.

country.description: The country the number belongs to, as a name, ISO2 code or dial code. Required when the number is written nationally, with no + and no international prefix.

name: format_fax_number
title: Format a fax number
